purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kasipul Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF, cropped around the final summary row for digit-level confirmation at 500 DPI. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election (2022 General Election, election id 5) session handshake.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the final summary row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (KASIPUL, code 245) was read from the visible 'CON 245' banner marker and the page 1 'Constituency KASIPUL / Code 245' header block before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final summary row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-245-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows, sourced from the pre-election (2022-06-20) First Schedule

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile exactly on the printed final summary row (candidate sum 48,720 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, unlike every other denominator mismatch documented in this Atlas so far, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (67,397) is LOWER than the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator (67,513) by 116, rather than higher via an uncounted special-facility station. No special-facility or non-ward polling-station code was found anywhere on this form's pages that would explain the gap in either direction, and both figures were independently re-confirmed (the printed total re-read at 500 DPI; the governed figure re-queried from data/indicators/registry/observations.json). No cause is asserted here since none is evidenced on the source; a plausible but unverified possibility is a minor difference between the pre-election (2022-06-20) First Schedule register total and the register as it stood on election day itself, but this is not asserted as fact. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
